title: Cross-environment replication of E518/E519 execution-position association
workload: Exact E515 serial dependent SHA256 chain; task_rounds=8000+2200*task_id; E516 3/2 integer half-up multiplier
primary_endpoint: Two-way task+run fixed-effects slope of log(duration_ms) against normalized within-run execution position on the balanced 6x24 holdout panel

hypotheses.H1: A broadly recurring runtime-state/warmup effect yields a negative execution-position slope in this new environment.
hypotheses.H2: The E519 negative slope is environment-specific; the new slope is near zero or reverses sign.
hypotheses.H3: Task-specific cost and run-level heterogeneity dominate; run-specific slopes remain mixed.

comparison.prior_claim: robust same-source candidate confound on one GitHub Actions container host; not multi-host replication

environment_preflight.note: Runtime profile differs from E516's reported 5 visible CPUs, but prior E516 did not record CPU model or hostname; distinct physical host identity is not authenticated.

exclusions: No task deletion from primary panel
No claims of independent host without verified hardware identity
interpretation_rule: One new execution environment can test transportability of the association but cannot establish multi-host reproducibility or a causal mechanism.

claim_boundary.independent_host_replication: NOT MEASURED unless hardware identity can be independently distinguished
